relationships.subject: SCN9A
relationships.evidence_quote: SCN9A encodes the alpha subunit of the voltage-gated sodium channel NaV1.7

relationships.subject: SCN9A c.377+7T>G
relationships.evidence_quote: A quantification study using real-time polymerase chain reaction showed a significant reduction of the NaV1.7 canonical transcript.

relationships.subject: SCN9A c.377+7T>G
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, these data widen the spectrum of SCN9A-related insensitivity to pain by describing a mutation causing NaV1.7 deficiency

key_findings: Novel homozygous SCN9A c.377+7T>G in a U12-type intron causes exon 3 skipping and intron retention and 12.5-25-fold reduced canonical transcript in a CIP patient.
Computational splicing predictors missed the defect.
